core_obligations: Decomposition (proof lines 4521-4527): 04MH gives U = coprod U_r by the rank of s; U_0 empty by surjectivity of s; membership is the degree of the scheme-theoretic fibre.

R-invariance (proof lines 4528-4536): for z in R with s(z) = u, t(z) = u', 02YE identifies pr_1^{-1}(z) as the base change of both fibres, so the degrees agree and u, u' lie in the same U_r; the pieces are R-invariant.
Constant rank on the restriction (proof lines 4536-4540): R_r = s^{-1}(U_r) with s of rank r, and t is isomorphic to s through the inverse of R_r, hence of rank r.
